saintapediafeedback-button-label: Label on the floating action button visible to all page visitors
saintapediafeedback-panel-title: Title of the feedback slide-up panel
saintapediafeedback-panel-subtitle: Instruction text above the category chips
saintapediafeedback-category-inaccurate: Category chip: information is factually wrong
saintapediafeedback-category-outdated: Category chip: content is no longer current
saintapediafeedback-category-needs-detai: Category chip: article needs more information
saintapediafeedback-category-confusing: Category chip: text is hard to understand
saintapediafeedback-category-broken-link: Category chip: links are dead or incorrect
saintapediafeedback-category-other: Category chip: catch-all for other issues
saintapediafeedback-comment-label: Label above the optional free-text comment field
saintapediafeedback-comment-placeholder: Placeholder shown in the comment box in public mode (max 500 chars)
saintapediafeedback-comment-placeholder-: Placeholder shown in the comment box in enterprise mode (max 5000 chars)
saintapediafeedback-email-label: Label above the optional email field (enterprise / enabled mode only)
saintapediafeedback-email-placeholder: Placeholder text inside the email input
saintapediafeedback-success-body: Body text shown after successful submission
saintapediafeedback-error-ratelimit: Shown when the submitter has hit the per-day rate limit
saintapediafeedback-error-nocategory: Shown when user tries to submit without selecting any category
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha: Shown when hCaptcha is missing or failed verification
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha-unavai: Shown when captcha is required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is not configured on the wiki
saintapediafeedback-error-namespace: Shown when API submit targets a page outside configured namespaces
saintapediafeedback-special-page-title: Title of the per-page feedback view. $1 = page name.
saintapediafeedback-special-pagename: Label for the article name field on the page selector
saintapediafeedback-special-submit: Submit button on the page selector form
saintapediafeedback-special-notfound: Error when a page ID is not found
saintapediafeedback-special-nofeedback: Shown when a page has no feedback yet
saintapediafeedback-special-categories: Prefix label before the list of reported categories on a feedback row
saintapediafeedback-status-updated: Confirmation message after changing a feedback row's status
saintapediafeedback-action-reviewed: Button to mark a feedback item as reviewed
saintapediafeedback-action-actioned: Button to mark a feedback item as actioned (resolved)
saintapediafeedback-action-dismissed: Button to dismiss a feedback item
saintapediafeedback-export-link: Wrapper text for the JSON export link. $1 = link.
saintapediafeedback-export-link-text: Link text for the JSON export
saintapediafeedback-view: Right required to view feedback on Special:SaintapediaFeedback
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-title: Title of the all-feedback admin dashboard
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-empty: Shown when filters match no feedback rows
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-showing: Pagination summary. $1 = first index, $2 = last index, $3 = total count.
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-page: Label before the article title on a dashboard row
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-page-only: Link to filter/view feedback for only that article
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-filtered-p: Shown when the dashboard is filtered to one article. $1 = article title.
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-clear-page: Link to remove the article filter from the dashboard
saintapediafeedback-lookup-help: Help text under the title lookup form that jumps to the per-article feedback view
saintapediafeedback-filter-page: Label for optional article title field in the dashboard filter form
saintapediafeedback-status-reviewed: Workflow status: editor has seen it
saintapediafeedback-status-actioned: Workflow status: fixed or acted on
saintapediafeedback-filter-category-all: Option to not filter by category
saintapediafeedback-filter-apply: Submit button on the filter form
saintapediafeedback-pagination-prev: Link to previous (newer) page of results
saintapediafeedback-pagination-next: Link to next (older) page of results
